before_times: What is the RV doing, and since when? In the customer's own words
Type (motorhome, travel trailer, fifth wheel, camper van), year, make and model
Length and height, and the mileage if it has an engine
Any propane smell, carbon monoxide alarm, burning smell or water near the wiring?
For a mobile job: where it's parked (home, storage lot, campground and site), and whether it has power and water hookups
after_time: Where will the customer stay while it's at the shop? Nobody stays in it, and no pets are left inside
Old parts back? Yes or no
Anything the technician should know, like when the leak or the noise happens
secure_page_only: The campground gate code and the site, or the lockbox code
Someone else who may say yes to the estimate, named in writing
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult: the RV's owner, or someone the owner lets bring it in; a renter or a borrower can book a diagnosis, but a repair needs the owner's yes, named in writing

safety_and_stop_words.stop_action: 'Get everyone out and away, and call 911' and the generic emergency steps; no booking

prep: Bring every key, including the compartment and storage-bay keys
Empty the refrigerator, and take out food, valuables and pets
Know where you'll stay while it's in the shop
For a mobile job: level ground, power and water hookups if you have them, and room for the slide-outs
first_steps_and_forms.required: none before the visit; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing on the drop-off page when booking

staff.licenses_or_certificates: each technician's certificates for the work they do: a propane certificate where the state requires one; an EPA certificate for refrigerant work, in every state; industry certificates as the business says
staff.supervision: an apprentice works only while a certified technician who may supervise them is on, where the state's rules require it
staff.who_oks: the owner or the service writer OKs estimates, added work and storage fees
staff.stand_in: only someone certified for that kind of work

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult: the RV's owner, or someone the owner lets bring it in; a renter or a borrower can book a diagnosis, but a repair needs the owner's yes, named in writing
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts about a teen's RV go to the parent who booked

visit.check_in: a drop-off: the customer gives the check-in code at the counter when leaving the RV. A key-box drop-off or a tow-in has no code: the technician texts IN once the RV and keys are found. Mobile: the code at the RV, as at any door.
visit.done: the drop-off code, or IN, checks the RV in; READY and the pick-up close it
visit.changes_at_visit: anything over the signed estimate needs a new yes before it's done, logged with the time, the phone and the new total

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: if: where the state registers repair shops or certifies technicians; a propane (LP-gas) certificate where the state requires one; an EPA certificate for refrigerant work
license.who: both: the shop, and each person
ask: The shop's repair-shop registration number, where the state has one
Each technician's certificates for the work they do: a propane certificate where the state requires one, and an EPA certificate for refrigerant work
Industry certificates (RV technician or inspector), shown only as what the business says
license.insurance: garage liability and coverage for customers' RVs in the shop's care, as the business says; shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie

never_in_a_text: The campground gate code or the lockbox code
